notes.title: KOOB DOG 1.8 Optimized
notes.content:
-Settings button added in the Paws menu
Low, Medium, and High options available to run Koob Dog in glorious 60 FPS!!!

notes.title: KOOB DOG 1.5 8/8/24
notes.content: -[u]Restart Button[/u] added in the corner of the Main Menu, selecting it will [u]reset your save[/u] and begin the game fresh from the start should you want to

notes.title: KOOB DOG 1.3 8/7/24
notes.content:
-Out of bounds walls added in spawn level

Please write a post if you find any issues.

notes.title: KOOB DOG 1.2 8/7/24
notes.content:
-Camera movement speed increased by 20%
-Time trial sword spawn fixed in Pyramid Plunge W3-3
-Crow ATK mid cutscene fixed in Destined Isle W3-1
-Intro cutscene sped up for Dog of Time W2-1
-Level buttons can be pressed while holding Swords in HUB
-Certain cutscenes now restrict movement for bug reasons

notes.title: KOOB DOG 1.1 8/4/24
notes.content:
-tutorial kill box adjusted
-last room in kastle konquest altered
-out of bounds fixes throughout

notes.title: KOOB DOG Hints & ?'s
notes.content: Use this as an old school game forum, I the developer will respond to your comments and try to hint you in the right direction for anything you might have trouble collecting. You may also ask any other questions you may have :) Enjoy KOOB DOG and happy collecting!
